context: M30 o1. Varelas office. Eleni's grey travelling suit. A suitcase by the door, or not.

lines.speaker: char.eleni_varelas
lines.text: Nikos. Kallis wants the firm. The Baeks want the building. Lisle wants your name.

lines.speaker: char.eleni_varelas
lines.text: I want to know what you'll do with the hotel with people in it.

lines.speaker: char.nick_varelas
lines.text: I'm going to go inside it. For the first time.

lines.speaker: char.eleni_varelas
lines.text: …Then I'll unpack after. If you come back the right man.
